body:
## What's Changed

Rename the complete d73af7b2 content snapshot to OVO 2.1.34. Preserve three-generation deployment recognition, existing credentials, resource identities and rollback. Fix demo API gaps and expired-session remounts; publish anonymous, checksummed installation assets.

## Release assets (14)

- gost-amd64
- gost-arm64
- gost-amd64.sha256
- gost-arm64.sha256
- install.sh
- panel_install.sh
- install.sh.sha256
- panel_install.sh.sha256
- docker-compose-v4.yml
- docker-compose-v6.yml
- docker-compose-v4.yml.sha256
- docker-compose-v6.yml.sha256
- ovo-skill-api-2.1.34.tgz
- ovo-skill-api-2.1.34.tgz.sha256

## 📝 Release Information

- **Version**: 2.1.34
- **Commit**: [`745cde4`](https://github.com/yhfc1775-maker/ovo/commit/745cde4dd765eee414ec9c651376cd928830c3d5)
- **Author**: yhfc1775-maker
- **Date**: 2026-11-28 10:48:21 +0800
- **Message**: Rename flmx-max to ovo for public release 2.1.34 (#1)

## 📦 Docker Images

```bash
# Backend
docker pull ghcr.io/yhfc1775-maker/ovo-panel-backend:2.1.34

# Frontend
docker pull ghcr.io/yhfc1775-maker/ovo-vite-frontend:2.1.34

# Agent (node container install form)
docker pull ghcr.io/yhfc1775-maker/ovo-agent:2.1.34
```

## 🚀 Quick Install

**Panel (安装此版本 2.1.34):**
```bash
curl -L https://github.com/yhfc1775-maker/ovo/releases/download/2.1.34/panel_install.sh -o panel_install.sh && curl -L https://github.com/yhfc1775-maker/ovo/releases/download/2.1.34/panel_install.sh.sha256 -o panel_install.sh.sha256 && sha256sum -c panel_install.sh.sha256 && chmod +x panel_install.sh && ./panel_install.sh
```

**Node (安装此版本 2.1.34):**
```bash
curl -L https://github.com/yhfc1775-maker/ovo/releases/download/2.1.34/install.sh -o install.sh && curl -L https://github.com/yhfc1775-maker/ovo/releases/download/2.1.34/install.sh.sha256 -o install.sh.sha256 && sha256sum -c install.sh.sha256 && chmod +x install.sh && ./install.sh
```
